name: Federal Bank Ltd
title: Federal Bank Ltd - 500469 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Federal Bank Q4 FY26 shows record profit of INR1,145 cr and ROA back to pre-rate-cut levels, but about INR456 cr one-off tax-refund interest flatters reported numbers and ECL transition is unquantified.

triggers.label: One-off tax refund gains flatter Q4
triggers.quote: the numbers I'm going to spell out are on the underlying performance metrics, which will be detailing our core earnings trajectory, excluding impact of one-off gains

triggers.label: Credit cost guidance held pending ECL
triggers.quote: we don't want to review our guidance for now

red_flags.label: One-off tax refund interest flatters profit
red_flags.quote: the INR456 crores number that you see in our -- as a one-off

red_flags.label: Floating provision of INR456 cr for ECL
red_flags.quote: floating provision has nothing whatsoever to do with asset quality

red_flags.label: Falling LCR buffer
red_flags.quote: we are currently operating at about 120% roughly

evasions.quote: Let me leave the guidance at that.
We don't want to quantify that
We will come back to you on this.
